title: "EDA — Microdatos Censo 2024 Spatialized to ZONA777"
format: html
---

## Objetivo

Este notebook audita las nuevas variables `ZONA777` derivadas desde microdatos comunales del Censo 2024 mediante la ruta:

- `microdatos comunales -> softmax_tau003 -> MANZENT -> ZONA777`

El foco es:

- validar la forma y cobertura del output nuevo;
- revisar sanidad básica de las variables derivadas;
- comparar la señal educativa nueva contra el Censo agregado tradicional;
- y dejar una shortlist razonable para llevar al modelo.

## Materializar piloto si falta

```{python}
#| label: build-pilot-if-missing
PILOT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
pilot_zona777_path = PILOT_DIR / "censo2024_microdata_zona777_features.parquet"
pilot_manzent_path = PILOT_DIR / "censo2024_microdata_manzent_features.parquet"
pilot_summary_path = PILOT_DIR / "censo2024_microdata_zona777_summary.json"

if not pilot_zona777_path.exists():
    should_rebuild_pilot = True
else:
    existing_cols = set(pl.scan_parquet(pilot_zona777_path).collect_schema().names())
    should_rebuild_pilot = "share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro" not in existing_cols

if should_rebuild_pilot:
    if pilot_zona777_path.exists():
        print("ℹ️ Piloto existente no tiene `share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro`; regenerando...")
    artifacts = build_spatialized_microdata_outputs(
        micro_paths=MicrodataPaths(
            personas_zip=PERSONAS_ZIP,
            hogares_zip=HOGARES_ZIP,
            viviendas_zip=VIVIENDAS_ZIP,
        ),
        base_zip=BASE_ZIP,
        carto_parquet=CARTO_MZ,
        zonas777_shp=ZONAS777_SHP,
        tau=TAU,
        seed=SEED,
        comuna_codes=PILOT_COMUNAS,
    )
    artifacts.manzent_features.to_parquet(pilot_manzent_path, index=False)
    artifacts.zona777_features.to_parquet(pilot_zona777_path, index=False)
    summary = {
        "n_households": int(len(artifacts.household_base)),
        "n_assigned_households": int(len(artifacts.household_assignment)),
        "n_manzent_features": int(len(artifacts.manzent_features)),
        "n_zona777_features": int(len(artifacts.zona777_features)),
        "tau": float(TAU),
        "seed": int(SEED),
        "comunas": [str(c) for c in PILOT_COMUNAS],
    }
    pilot_summary_path.write_text(pd.Series(summary).to_json(indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
else:
    print("ℹ️ Reusando piloto existente con `universitaria_o_mas` ya materializada.")

print("pilot_zona777_path:", pilot_zona777_path)
print("pilot_manzent_path:", pilot_manzent_path)
print("pilot_summary_path:", pilot_summary_path)
```

## Cargar datos

```{python}
#| label: load-data
df_micro = pl.read_parquet(pilot_zona777_path).sort("ZONA777")
df_micro_manz = pl.read_parquet(pilot_manzent_path)
df_official = pl.read_parquet(OFFICIAL_CENSO_ZONA777).sort("ZONA777")

gdf_zonas = gpd.read_file(ZONAS777_SHP)[["ZONA777", "geometry"]].copy()
gdf_zonas = gdf_zonas.set_crs("EPSG:4674", allow_override=True)
if gdf_zonas["ZONA777"].duplicated().any():
    gdf_zonas = gdf_zonas.dissolve(by="ZONA777", as_index=False)
    gdf_zonas = gpd.GeoDataFrame(gdf_zonas, geometry="geometry", crs="EPSG:4674")

print("df_micro shape:", df_micro.shape)
print("df_micro_manz shape:", df_micro_manz.shape)
print("df_official shape:", df_official.shape)
```

## Sanidad básica

```{python}
#| label: microdata-zona777-quality-summary
print("label: microdata-zona777-quality-summary")

def socio_quality_summary(df: pl.DataFrame, socio_vars: list[str]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    exprs = []
    for c in socio_vars:
        exprs.extend([pl.col(c).min().alias(f"{c}_min"), pl.col(c).max().alias(f"{c}_max")])
        if c != "prom_escolaridad18_micro":
            exprs.extend(
                [
                    (pl.col(c) > 1).sum().alias(f"{c}_gt1"),
                    (pl.col(c) < 0).sum().alias(f"{c}_lt0"),
                ]
            )
        exprs.append(pl.col(c).is_null().sum().alias(f"{c}_nulls"))
    return df.select(exprs)

with pl.Config(tbl_rows=-1, tbl_cols=-1, tbl_width_chars=1000):
    display(socio_quality_summary(df_micro, ALL_MICRO_VARS))

```

## Zonas problemáticas

```{python}
#| label: microdata-zona777-problematic-zones
print("label: microdata-zona777-problematic-zones")
for c in ALL_MICRO_VARS:
    if c == "prom_escolaridad18_micro":
        bad = (
            df_micro
            .filter(pl.col(c).is_null())
            .select(["ZONA777", c])
            .sort("ZONA777")
        )
    else:
        bad = (
            df_micro
            .filter((pl.col(c) > 1) | (pl.col(c) < 0) | pl.col(c).is_null())
            .select(["ZONA777", c])
            .sort("ZONA777")
        )
    print(f"\nVariable: {c}")
    print(f"n zonas problemáticas: {bad.height}")
    display(bad)
```

## Mapas educación

```{python}
#| label: microdata-zona777-maps-education
print("label: microdata-zona777-maps-education")

def render_spatial_maps(
    *,
    gdf_zonas_base: gpd.GeoDataFrame,
    df_model_ready: pl.DataFrame,
    socio_vars: list[str],
    plot_cfg: dict[str, dict[str, str]],
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    gdf_plot = gdf_zonas_base.merge(df_model_ready.to_pandas(), on="ZONA777", how="left")
    ncols = 2
    nrows = int((len(socio_vars) + ncols - 1) / ncols)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols, figsize=(14, 6 * nrows))
    axes = axes.flatten() if hasattr(axes, "flatten") else [axes]

    for ax, var in zip(axes, socio_vars):
        cfg = plot_cfg[var]
        gdf_plot.plot(
            column=var,
            ax=ax,
            cmap=cfg["cmap"],
            linewidth=0.15,
            edgecolor="white",
            legend=True,
            legend_kwds={"shrink": 0.75},
            missing_kwds={"color": "#d9d9d9", "label": "Sin dato"},
        )
        q = (
            df_model_ready
            .select(
                pl.col(var).min().alias("min"),
                pl.col(var).median().alias("median"),
                pl.col(var).max().alias("max"),
            )
            .row(0, named=True)
        )
        ax.set_title(
            f"{cfg['title']}\nmin={q['min']:.3f} | mediana={q['median']:.3f} | max={q['max']:.3f}",
            fontsize=11,
        )
        ax.set_axis_off()

    for ax in axes[len(socio_vars):]:
        ax.set_axis_off()

    fig.suptitle(title, fontsize=15, y=0.98)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
    print("Mapa guardado en:", output_path)
    plt.show()

education_cfg = {
    "prom_escolaridad18_micro": {"title": "Promedio escolaridad 18+ (micro)", "cmap": "viridis"},
    "share_cine18_primaria_micro": {"title": "Share CINE 18+ primaria", "cmap": "Reds"},
    "share_cine18_secundaria_micro": {"title": "Share CINE 18+ secundaria", "cmap": "Blues"},
    "share_cine18_terciaria_corta_micro": {"title": "Share CINE 18+ terciaria corta", "cmap": "YlGnBu"},
    "share_cine18_universitaria_micro": {"title": "Share CINE 18+ universitaria", "cmap": "PuBuGn"},
    "share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro": {"title": "Share CINE 18+ universitaria o más", "cmap": "GnBu"},
    "share_cine18_postgrado_micro": {"title": "Share CINE 18+ postgrado", "cmap": "BuPu"},
}

render_spatial_maps(
    gdf_zonas_base=gdf_zonas,
    df_model_ready=df_micro,
    socio_vars=EDUCATION_VARS,
    plot_cfg=education_cfg,
    title="Microdatos spatialized -> ZONA777 | Bloque educación",
    output_path=PILOT_DIR / "microdata_zona777_education_maps.png",
)
```

## Matriz de correlación nueva

```{python}
#| label: microdata-zona777-correlation-matrix
print("label: microdata-zona777-correlation-matrix")

def render_corr_matrix(
    *,
    df_model_ready: pl.DataFrame,
    socio_vars: list[str],
    title: str,
    output_path: Path,
) -> None:
    df_corr_input = pd.DataFrame(df_model_ready.select(socio_vars).to_dicts())
    df_corr = df_corr_input.corr(method="pearson", numeric_only=True)
    display(df_corr.round(3))

    pairs = []
    vars_ = list(df_corr.columns)
    for i, var_i in enumerate(vars_):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(vars_)):
            var_j = vars_[j]
            corr_ij = float(df_corr.loc[var_i, var_j])
            pairs.append({"var_1": var_i, "var_2": var_j, "corr": corr_ij, "abs_corr": abs(corr_ij)})

    display(
        pl.DataFrame(pairs).sort("abs_corr", descending=True))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 7))
    im = ax.imshow(df_corr.values, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-1, vmax=1)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(vars_)))
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(vars_)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(vars_, rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_yticklabels(vars_)
    for i in range(len(vars_)):
        for j in range(len(vars_)):
            ax.text(j, i, f"{df_corr.iloc[i, j]:.2f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title(title)
    fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
    print("Matriz guardada en:", output_path)
    plt.show()

render_corr_matrix(
    df_model_ready=df_compare,
    socio_vars=[
        "prom_escolaridad18_micro",
        "share_cine18_primaria_micro",
        "share_cine18_secundaria_micro",
        "share_cine18_terciaria_corta_micro",
        "share_cine18_universitaria_micro",
        "share_cine18_universitaria_o_mas_micro",
        "share_cine18_postgrado_micro",
        "share_ocupado_15mas_micro",
        "share_fuera_fuerza_trabajo_15mas_micro",
        "share_dependiente_micro",
        "share_independiente_micro",
        "share_discapacidad_5mas_micro",
        "share_analfabet_15mas_micro",
        "prom_escolaridad18",
    ],
    title="Matriz de correlación | microdatos spatialized + benchmark Censo agregado",
    output_path=PILOT_DIR / "microdata_zona777_corr_matrix.png",
)
```
